```llp
type level {low mid high}.
pred place_level(level, object, receptacle) : alf.
weight where(O, R) reads {inrecep(O, R)}.
pred want(object) : alf.
pred carrying(object) : alf.
pred togo(receptacle) : alf.
pred toopen(receptacle) : alf.
pred todest(receptacle) : alf.
%% I'll take {O} for this.
choose [dyn] : unchosen * $target(O) -o want(O).
%% I go to where {O} is.
go_obj [dyn] : want(O) * at(L) * $objat(O, L2) * $inrecep(O, R) * $recat(R, L2) * L <> L2 -o want(O) * at(L2).
%% I open {R}.
open_closed [dyn] : toopen(R) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * closed(R) -o opened(R) * checked(R).
%% {O} is inside {R}: I open it.
need_open [dyn] : want(O) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $inrecep(O, R) * $openable(R) * $closed(R) -o want(O) * toopen(R).
%% I take {O} from {R}.
take_plain [dyn] : want(O) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * inrecep(O, R) * objat(O, L) * handsfree * $notopenable(R) -o holds(O) * holding * carrying(O).
%% I take {O} from {R}.
take_open [dyn] : want(O) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * inrecep(O, R) * objat(O, L) * handsfree * $opened(R) -o holds(O) * holding * carrying(O).
%% I carry {O} to {R}.
go [dyn] : togo(R) * at(L) * $recat(R, L2) * L <> L2 -o at(L2).
%% I head for {R}.
deliver [dyn] : carrying(O) * $at(L) * $dest(R) * $recat(R, L2) * L <> L2 -o carrying(O) * togo(R).
%% {R} must be opened first.
mark_closed_dest [dyn] : carrying(O) * $at(L) * $dest(R) * $recat(R, L) * $closed(R) -o carrying(O) * toopen(R).
%% {R} is the place.
place [dyn] : carrying(O) * $at(L) * $dest(R) * $recat(R, L) -o carrying(O) * todest(R).
%% I put {O} in {R}.
put_plain [dyn] : todest(R) * carrying(O) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * holds(O) * holding * $notopenable(R) -o inrecep(O, R) * objat(O, L) * handsfree * placed.
%% I put {O} in {R}.
put_open [dyn] : todest(R) * carrying(O) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * holds(O) * holding * $opened(R) -o inrecep(O, R) * objat(O, L) * handsfree * placed.
%% {O} is likely at {R}: I go and look.
go_look [dyn] : want(O) * at(L) * $place_level(mid, O, R) * $recat(R, L2) * L <> L2 -o want(O) * at(L2).
%% {O} is surely at {R}: I go and look.
go_look_high [dyn] : want(O) * at(L) * $place_level(high, O, R) * $recat(R, L2) * L <> L2 -o want(O) * at(L2).
%% {O} may be inside {R}: I open it to look.
peek [dyn] : want(O) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $place_level(mid, O, R) * $closed(R) -o want(O) * toopen(R).
%% {O} is likely inside {R}: I open it to look.
peek_high [dyn] : want(O) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $place_level(high, O, R) * $closed(R) -o want(O) * toopen(R).
```
